mapper.insert: insert into TBL_TRANSACTION (USER_ID, CATEGORY_ID, PAYMENT_METHOD_ID, PERIOD_ID, TRANSACTION_DATE, TRANSACTION_AMOUNT, TRANSACTION_TYPE, TRANSACTION_TITLE,MEMO) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{paymentMethodId}, #{periodId},#{transactionDate},#{transactionAmount},#{transactionType},#{transactionTitle},#{memo})
mapper.select: select n.n as day, coalesce(s.sum, 0) as sum from T_NUMBERS n left join ( select day(t.TRANSACTION_DATE) as day, sum(t.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT) as sum from TBL_TRANSACTION t where t.USER_ID = #{userId} and t.TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'EXPENSE' and t.TRANSACTION_DATE >= DATE (#{startOfMonth}) and t.TRANSACTION_DATE < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{startOfMonth}), INTERVAL 1 MONTH ) group by day(t.TRANSACTION_DATE) ) s on s.day = n.n where n.n <= day(last_day(date(#{startOfMonth}))) order by n.n

select total.user_id, total.payment_method_name, total.transaction_id, total.category_id, total.period_id, total.transaction_date, total.transaction_amount, total.transaction_type, total.transaction_title, total.create_at, total.memo, total.payment_method_id, c.CATEGORY_NAME from (select t.payment_method_id, t.user_id, payment_method_name, transaction_id, category_id, period_id, transaction_date, transaction_amount, transaction_type, transaction_title, retrieve_status, t.create_at, memo from TBL_PAYMENT_METHOD p join TBL_TRANSACTION t on p.PAYMENT_METHOD_ID = t.PAYMENT_METHOD_ID where p.USER_ID = #{userId}) total left join TBL_CATEGORY c on total.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID where TRANSACTION_DATE = #{transactionDate}
